# IranAPI

IranAPI is a developer API hub and control plane for Iranian product teams: browse a
vetted API catalog, inspect OpenAPI-backed documentation, test public endpoints, and
publish your own integrations from the same dashboard.

## Public routes (SPA)
- `/` — landing page with live catalog stats
- `/browse` — API catalog (searchable, filterable, sortable)
- `/documentation` — machine-readable API docs
- `/pricing` — plans and quotas
- `/cli` — CLI download (iranapi-cli, npm-installable)
- `/release` — publish a new API to the catalog
- `/caller` — test/consume a public endpoint

## Machine endpoints
- `/api/v1/system/health/` — service + MongoDB health check
- `/api/v1/catalog/apis/` — catalog entries (queryset, paginated)
- `/api/v1/catalog/categories/` — categories
- `/api/v1/catalog/documentations/` — documentation entries
- `/api/v1/schema/openapi.json` — canonical OpenAPI 3.0 schema for this API
- `/cli/manifest.json` — no-cache runtime discovery for the current temporary host
- `/downloads/iranapi-cli.tgz` — host-relative latest CLI package alias

## Formats & conventions
- All dynamic data is served as JSON (REST, Django Rest Framework).
- Catalog entries link their endpoint and documentation resources for exact request/response shapes.
- The frontend is a bilingual (en/fa, RTL-aware) single-page application.

## Notes for AI agents
- The deployment domain is temporary; resolve all absolute URLs against the host this
  file is served from.
- Structured site metadata is available in the `application/ld+json` block in the
  document head of the SPA entry page.
- Health endpoint returns 200 only when MongoDB is reachable.
